translations.zh: 永康元年，詔征益州刺史趙廞為大長秋，以成都內史耿滕代廞。
translations.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, an edict summoned Zhao Xin, inspector of Yi Province, as Grand Chamberlain and appointed Geng Teng, interior minister of Chengdu, to replace Xin.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongkang 1 an edict summoned Zhao Xin, inspector of Yi Province, as Grand Chamberlain and appointed Geng Teng, interior minister of Chengdu, to replace him.

translations.zh: 廞遂謀叛，潛有劉氏割據之志，乃傾倉廩，振施流人，以收眾心。
translations.literal: Xin then plotted rebellion, secretly harboring the ambition to carve out a Liu domain; he emptied the granaries and distributed relief to the refugees to win hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Xin then plotted rebellion, secretly harboring the ambition to hold a Liu domain; he emptied the granaries, relieved the refugees, and sought to win their loyalty.

translations.zh: 特之党類皆巴西人，與廞同郡，率多勇壯，廞厚遇之，以為爪牙，故特等聚眾，專為寇盜，蜀人患之。
translations.literal: Li Te's followers were all men of Baxi, the same commandery as Xin, and mostly bold and strong; Xin treated them generously and used them as claws and teeth, so Te and his men gathered bands and devoted themselves to plunder, to the distress of the people of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Te's followers were all men of Baxi, Xin's home commandery, and mostly bold warriors; Xin favored them as his strong arm, so Te and his men gathered bands and devoted themselves to plunder, to the distress of Shu.

translations.zh: 滕密上表，以為流人剛剽而蜀人懦弱，客主不能相制，必為亂階，宜使移還其本。
translations.literal: Teng secretly submitted a memorial, arguing that the refugees were fierce and the Shu people soft, that guest and host could not restrain each other and would surely become a source of disorder, and that they should be sent back to their native places.
translations.idiomatic: Teng secretly memorialized that the refugees were fierce while the Shu people were mild, that guest and host could not restrain each other and would surely bring disorder, and that the refugees should be sent back to their native places.

translations.zh: 若致之險地，將恐秦雍之禍萃于梁益，必貽聖朝西顧之憂。
translations.literal: If they were kept in this dangerous region, he feared the calamities of Qin and Yong would gather in Liang and Yi and would surely burden the holy court with worry for the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: If they were kept in this dangerous region, he feared the troubles of Qin and Yong would gather in Liang and Yi and would surely burden the court with worry for the western frontier.

translations.literal: Xin heard of it and hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xin heard of it and hated him.

translations.zh: 時益州文武千餘人已往迎滕，滕率眾入州，廞遣眾逆滕，戰于西門，滕敗，死之。
translations.literal: By then more than a thousand civil and military officers of Yi Province had gone to welcome Teng; Teng led his forces into the province, Xin dispatched troops to oppose Teng, they fought at the West Gate, Teng was defeated and died.
translations.idiomatic: By then more than a thousand civil and military officers of Yi Province had gone to welcome Teng; Teng led his forces into the province, Zhao Xin dispatched troops to oppose him, they fought at the West Gate, and Teng was defeated and killed.
